retrieval.query: When is annual enrollment in 2026, and when do my changes take effect?

response.text: Annual enrollment is November 2-20, 2026. Changes take effect January 1, 2027.

evidence.quote: Annual enrollment runs from November 2 through November 20, 2026.
Changes selected during annual enrollment take effect on January 1, 2027.

retrieval.query: After the birth of a child, how soon must I report the life event and what dependent proof is required?

response.text: Report the birth within 30 calendar days and upload a birth certificate to add the child.

evidence.quote: Report a qualifying life event through Benefits > Life Events within 30 calendar days of the event.
To add a child, upload a birth certificate or adoption order.

retrieval.query: An old policy says wellness reimbursement is $200. What is the current 2026 annual limit?

response.text: The current wellness limit is $300 per employee per calendar year.

evidence.quote: Wellness reimbursement is limited to $300 per employee per calendar year.

retrieval.query: Are wellness and commuter paid receipts both due within 60 days?

response.text: Commuter receipts are due within 60 days; wellness receipts are due within 90 days.

evidence.quote: Submit a paid transit receipt within 60 calendar days of purchase.
Submit a paid, itemized receipt within 90 calendar days of the purchase date.

retrieval.query: Has my reimbursement claim been paid today?

response.text: This knowledge base does not contain your personal claim status. Check Benefits > Claims.

retrieval.query: What is the policy for international employee relocation expenses?

response.text: The knowledge base does not document international relocation expenses.
